It includes or links the components below, under their own licences.


PROJECT LINEAGE AND DATA
------------------------
- Aether - Aion 2 DPS meter (global)
  https://github.com/Helveticxa/Aether-Aion2-DPS-meter-Global
  GPL-3.0. This project is a fork of it.
- NOIA2 by ZDYoung0519
  https://github.com/ZDYoung0519/NOIA2
  GPL-3.0. Aether is a fork of it; the capture pipeline, packet parsers and
  game-data catalogues come from there.
- Kuroukihime/AIon2-Dps-Meter
  https://github.com/Kuroukihime/AIon2-Dps-Meter
  GPL-3.0. English monster and boss names, skill names and server codes in
  the bundled data are derived from it.


BUNDLED COMPONENTS
------------------
- WinDivert 2.2.2 by basil00 (WinDivert.dll, WinDivert64.sys), unmodified.
  https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert
  Dual-licensed under the LGPL-3.0 or the GPL-2.0; the licence text is
  reproduced in full below. The source is available at the address above.
- Barlow Semi Condensed font, embedded in the exe.
  https://github.com/jpt/barlow
  SIL Open Font License 1.1; reproduced below.
- Lucide icons, embedded in the exe.
  https://lucide.dev
  ISC licence (parts MIT, Feather); reproduced below.
- GPUI (crates gpui-pre and gpui-pre-*), the UI framework, from the Zed project.
  https://github.com/zed-industries/zed
  Apache-2.0; reproduced below.
- embed-resource by nabijaczleweli, vendored in vendor/embed-resource (build
  tool, patched; not part of the running program).
  MIT; reproduced below.
- Npcap is NOT bundled. If you install it, it is under its own licence from
  https://npcap.com.
